race.comment: MACHRIMORE (4) has transferred from the Archibald stable to Michael Hickmott and is back after an eight-month break. Beaten just a long neck when fresh from a spell over 1350m at the Beaumont track last prep, then failed in two Queensland runs. Easy recent trial winner who has the class to take this out. OLYMPIA FIELDS (5) is a new arrival in the Grant Kluske yard and is fresh from a six-month lay-off. Placed once in four runs last prep when prepared by the Hayes boys. Expect she is up for this. GRECIAN JEWEL (11) wasn't far away on debut over this distance at Murray Bridge then struggled in town. Can bounce back in this far more suitable assignment. CRAZYABOUTZOU (10) found 1000m too slick when fresh from a spell at Murray Bridge (metro) recently. Can do a lot better under today's set-up. First starter STEELY MISS (13) ran a nice trial at Morphettville Parks a fortnight ago and should be monitored for market support.
